title: Parallel Worlds
tagline: Four worlds. Four Anchor Stars. One gate that is about to close.

ui.noItems: Nothing yet. Look around the room.
ui.noTruths: No truths yet. Finish a world to learn one.
ui.holdHelp: Now tap the right spot in the room.
ui.needItem: You need something for this. Open the notebook and hold an item.
ui.hintDone: Nothing left to solve here. Take the way out.
ui.hintPoor: Not enough {score} for a hint. You need {cost}.

mission.heading: The Seam
paras: You are Mara Quill, a cartographer, and Jonas Reeve, an instrument maker. Your mentor, Professor Ilsa Venn, has just stepped into a glowing slit in her study wall, the Seam.
Four Anchor Stars, one hidden in each world beyond it, can hold the gate open. Orrin, her small clockwork owl, will guide you.
Find all four stars and bring Ilsa home before the gate closes in five minutes.

tutorial.text: Drag to look around. Glowing things can be tapped.
Pick up items and read clues. Open the notebook to see them.
Every room has one puzzle. Close it any time with the X. Wrong answers cost 10 Wonder.
You have 3 hints for the whole game, each costs 25 Wonder. Watch the clock.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: Ilsa stepped into the Seam, and the wall closed over her light.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: Then we follow. Four Anchor Stars will hold the gate open, Mara.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Tick, tock. Five minutes before the Seam seals. I know the way.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Hoo. Look again. Brass hides what lamplight loves.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: Her study. Everything is where she left it, except her.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: Her map table. A star must be hidden near here.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: A brass pin. Ilsa marked every cache with these.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: Her folding compass. Bearings never lied to her.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: The telescope's lens, loose. She watched something far away.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: The compass rose banner. Her first bearing is stitched underneath.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Hoo. The wall map has a second mark, from the windmill.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: There! The first Anchor Star, glowing right in the map!

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: One world held. She meant us to find these in order.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Two landmarks, two bearings. The banner and the wall map hold both.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Draw 135 from the Lamp Tower and 180 from the Windmill. Pin where they cross.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: That spot touches only one line. The pin belongs where both cross.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: Check both bearings, then pin the crossing.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: Snow, brass and aurora. We are far from the study.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: The airship mast is frozen high. The winch must lower it.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: A valve wheel, frosted over. The winch is missing exactly this.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: Fur mittens. Small enough to be Ilsa's.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Hoo. A dock pass signed I. Venn. She came this way.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Flame, bend, wheel. The vault door lists the order.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: The dockmaster's note. Steam must never leak before the valve.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: It fits. Now the steam needs a clear road.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: The winch groans! The mast lowers and a star drops down.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: Each star keeps one world steady. Ilsa knew that.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Turn the pipes so steam runs from the boiler to the winch.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Red glow means an open end. Join every pipe, then open the valve.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: Steam is leaking. Every pipe end must meet another.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: Find the red glows and turn those pipes.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: Glass trees under two moons. It is perfectly silent.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: The five lamp posts are dark. Light them and something wakes.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: A glass lotus. It hums when moonlight touches it.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: Moonwater, still glowing. Lamps would love this.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Hoo. A mirror shard. Mind your fingers, and your reflection.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Two moons, two lights. Three things must cross the lake.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: The big globe maps the five posts. It is fragile.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: All five lamps blaze! The third star floats free.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: Light carried carefully, never left alone. Like Ilsa's advice.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: The wisp cracks glass. Never leave it alone with the globe or the lamp.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Wisp over, back alone, globe over, wisp back, lamp over, back alone, wisp over.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: The wisp shattered something. Keep it apart from the glass.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: Only one thing fits on the skiff with me.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: The Gate of Worlds. Every bridge ends here.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: Ilsa is somewhere beyond that arch. The gate is humming.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: A drifting map page. The ink is still wet.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: Another page. A coast I have never seen drawn.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Hoo. Pages escape when a map wants adding to.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: A banner with a moon and compass. It names runes one and five.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: This banner shows a lamp. Rune nine finishes the path.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: The light reaches the gate! The last Anchor Star is in my hands.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: Four stars. The Seam is wide open. Let us bring her home.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: The banners name the runes to press. Each switch also flips its neighbours.

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Press runes 1, 5 and 9 once each.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: The light stops short. Try the runes the banners name.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: Each rune flips its neighbours too. Count carefully.

dialogue.speaker: mara
dialogue.text: Then stay with us. We will find another way, Ilsa.

dialogue.speaker: jonas
dialogue.text: You walked into the Seam on purpose. That is the truth, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: orrin
dialogue.text: Hoo. A gate needs a keeper. She decided long before we arrived.

pin.name: Brass Pin
pin.text: One of Ilsa's cache pins, for marking a place on a map.

compass.name: Folding Compass
compass.text: Ilsa's pocket compass. North is marked with a tiny star.

lens.name: Telescope Lens
lens.text: A loose lens from the study telescope, warm from lamplight.

valve.name: Valve Wheel
valve.text: A frosted brass valve wheel. It belongs on the winch.

mittens.name: Fur Mittens
mittens.text: Small fur mittens, left on a crate in a hurry.

pass.name: Dock Pass
pass.text: A Skyport pass signed I. Venn, dated tonight.

lotus.name: Glass Lotus
lotus.text: A crystal flower that hums softly under moonlight.

phial.name: Moonwater Phial
phial.text: A phial of glowing water from the mirror lake.

shard.name: Mirror Shard
shard.text: A shard of the mirror lake. It shows a tall figure walking away.

page1.name: Map Page: Snow
page1.text: A drifting page showing a snow harbour that is not on any map.

page2.name: Map Page: Glass
page2.text: A drifting page showing a glass forest under two moons.

page3.name: Map Page: Gold
page3.text: A drifting page with a golden desert and a ruined arch.

star1.name: Anchor Star 1
star1.text: The Anchor Star of the Study. It holds the gate steady.

star2.name: Anchor Star 2
star2.text: The Anchor Star of the Skyport. It holds the gate steady.

star3.name: Anchor Star 3
star3.text: The Anchor Star of the Glass Forest. It holds the gate steady.

star4.name: Anchor Star 4
star4.text: The Anchor Star of the Gate. It holds the gate steady.

truths: The Seam opens only for someone who chooses to cross.
Each Anchor Star holds one world's edge steady.
A gate held open by force tears the worlds apart. It needs a keeper.
Ilsa left on purpose. She chose to become the gate's keeper.

r1.title: Bearings on the Map
r1.help: Columns A-I run left to right, rows 1-9 from the bottom. Tap a landmark, pick a bearing to draw a line, then pin the place where both lines cross.
r1.pinHelp: Tap the marked spot where both lines cross.
r1.rules: The pin can only go on a marked spot, and only after both lines are drawn.

r2.title: Steam Pipes
r2.help: Tap a pipe to turn it. Red glow = open end. Blue = steam.
r2.noValve: The valve wheel is not on the winch yet.
r2.rules: No pipe may have an open end (red glow). Do not open the valve until every pipe is joined.

r3.title: The Mirror Skiff
r3.help: Carry the lamp parts across the mirror lake to the posts. Step 1: tap one thing on Mara's bank to load it (or carry nothing). Step 2: press Cross.
r3.wreck: Crack! The wisp shattered something. Start again.
r3.rules: The skiff carries Mara and ONE thing. The Shard Wisp must never be left alone with the Moon Globe or the Star Lamp. The globe and lamp are safe together.
r3.warn: Careful! {a} and {b} would be left alone together.
r3.allDone: All safe at the lamp posts!

r4.title: Rune Switches
r4.help: Each rune flips its own light and the lights next to it. Match the glowing path to the gate.
r4.rules: You cannot flip one light alone. Every rune also flips its neighbours.

rooms.name: The Cartographer's Study
rooms.objective: Fix the place marked X on the table map.
rooms.objectiveReady: Use the bearings you found on the table map.

reward.toast: Anchor Star 1 rises from the map.

hotspots.label: Compass rose banner
hotspots.title: Compass Rose Banner
hotspots.text: Stitched under the rose: "From the Lamp Tower (C7), the cache lies on bearing 135, south-east."

hotspots.label: World map
hotspots.title: Pencilled World Map
hotspots.text: Pencilled on the wall map: "From the Windmill (F8), the cache lies due south, bearing 180. Where both lines cross, the cache is."

hotspots.label: Old globe
hotspots.title: The Old Globe
views: A brass-ringed globe. One side has no ocean at all, only blank paper.
Tiny letters near the pole: "Every world is a page. Mind the edges."
hotspots.secret: Ilsa wrote "Sequel" in pencil, then rubbed it out.

rooms.name: The Skyport Dock
rooms.objective: Fit the valve wheel on the winch, then lower the mast.
rooms.objectiveReady: Now fix the steam pipes at the gear works.

reward.toast: The mast lowers. Anchor Star 2 is yours.

hotspots.label: Vault door symbols
hotspots.title: Vault Door Symbols
hotspots.text: Three dials on the vault door show a flame, a pipe bend and a wheel. Heat first, then pipes, then the wheel turns.

hotspots.label: Dock desk
hotspots.title: Dockmaster's Note
hotspots.text: Never open the valve until every pipe is joined. A pipe with a red glow is leaking steam.

rooms.name: The Glass Forest
rooms.objectiveReady: Carry the lamp parts across the mirror lake.

reward.toast: The lamps blaze. Anchor Star 3 floats free.

hotspots.label: Two moons
hotspots.title: Two Moons
hotspots.text: Three things must cross the mirror lake to the lamp posts: a Moon Globe, a Star Lamp and a Shard Wisp. The wisp cracks any glass left alone with it.

hotspots.label: Glass globe
hotspots.title: The Great Globe
hotspots.text: The skiff carries Mara and one thing at a time. The globe and the lamp are safe together.

hotspots.label: Mirror lake
hotspots.title: The Mirror Lake
views: The still water shows the moons twice, and a tall figure far away.
The figure raises a hand to the lamp posts, then turns away.
hotspots.secret: In the reflection the posts are already lit.

rooms.name: The Gate of Worlds
rooms.objective: Light the path to the great gate.
rooms.objectiveReady: Set the rune switches on the bridge.

hotspots.label: Left banner
hotspots.title: Moon Banner
hotspots.text: The moon-and-compass banner marks rune 1 and rune 5 on the bridge rails.

hotspots.label: Right banner
hotspots.title: Lamp Banner
hotspots.text: The lamp banner marks rune 9. Together the three runes light the path.

hotspots.label: Great arch
hotspots.title: The Great Arch
views: The arch is empty, but light pours out of it like a door left ajar.
Low on the stone: "I.V." and the mark of a keeper.
hotspots.secret: A keeper stays so the gate can hold.

cinematic: The four Anchor Stars lock into the arch. The Gate of Worlds opens with a sound like a thousand pages turning.
Ilsa Venn stands in the light, calm and smiling. She does not step through.
"A gate held open by force tears the worlds apart," Ilsa says. "It needs a keeper. I chose to be one."
Ilsa smiles, presses her folded map into Mara's hands, and steps back into the light as keeper of the gate.
Back in the study, the map unrolls on the table. One blank page begins to draw itself, line by line.

win.title: The Gate Holds
win.text: Four stars, four worlds, one keeper. Ilsa guards the gate, and the map is yours now.

timeup.title: The Seam Closes
timeup.text: The gate slips shut before the last star. The worlds are still waiting.
